definitions.explanation: an argument or statement made in opposition to another

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{意見|いけん}に{反論|はんろん}した。
{反論|はんろん}の{余地|よち}がない。
{誰|だれ}も{反論|はんろん}できないほど{説得力|せっとくりょく}があった。
examples.english: It was so persuasive that no one could object.

notes:
Composed of {反|はん} (anti-, counter-) + {論|ろん} (argument, theory). Refers to an argument made in opposition to another person's claim or position.

PATTERNS:
- [person]に{反論|はんろん}する: to argue against [person]
- [opinion]に{反論|はんろん}する: to rebut [opinion]
- {反論|はんろん}を{述|の}べる: to state a counterargument

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反論|はんろん}の{余地|よち}がない: no room for argument
- {反論|はんろん}を{許|ゆる}さない: to not allow objections
- {反論|はんろん}できない: cannot argue against
- {激|はげ}しい{反論|はんろん}: fierce rebuttal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {異論|いろん}: dissenting opinion (milder — simply a different view)
- {異議|いぎ}: objection (formal, often legal: {異議|いぎ}あり = "objection!")
- {抗議|こうぎ}: protest (broader — can involve actions, not just arguments)
- {批判|ひはん}: criticism (evaluative, not necessarily a direct counter-argument)
